description: This file defines a utility class 'Is' in the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace, providing static methods to check the state of promise objects such as pending, settled, fulfilled, or rejected.

classes.name: Is
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to determine the state of promise objects.

methods.name: pending
methods.description: Checks if the promise is pending.

methods.name: settled
methods.description: Checks if the promise is either fulfilled or rejected (i.e., settled).

methods.name: fulfilled
methods.description: Checks if the promise is fulfilled.

methods.name: rejected
methods.description: Checks if the promise is rejected.
